2123574999403381014.en_summary: Market Awareness is everything. Earlier this year, AI semis and tech ran 50% in days. Trend and sentiment were bullish, so buying any dip worked. Earnings sent stocks like $AMD and $AVGO up 100 points. That was the sentiment: valuations didn't matter. Markets move in cycles. Don't destroy your account buying AI in a bearish trend. What is the market telling us? Every pop gets sold, crazy overnight moves, morning gains fade by midday, weekly charts broken, heavy overhead supply, institutional levels/MAs broken, bad breadth, VIX does not budge. That isn't a market ready to trend higher. It's a market full of sellers using every bounce to get out.
2123574999403381014.zh_summary: 市場意識就是一切。今年早些時候，AI半導體和科技在幾天內上漲50%。趨勢和情緒看漲，所以買入任何回調都有效。財報讓像 $AMD 和 $AVGO 這樣的股票上漲100點。那是情緒：估值不重要。市場按周期移動。不要在看跌趨勢中買入AI而摧毀你的帳戶。市場告訴我們什麼？每次反彈都被賣出，瘋狂的隔夜波動，早盤漲幅中午消退，週圖表破裂，沉重的上方供應，機構水平/均線破裂，寬度差，VIX不動。那不是準備趨勢向上的市場。這是一個充滿賣家的市場，利用每次反彈出場。
